author: Krono III
title: Mechanistic Probe v5: Temporal Structure of Features
abstract: Heeding reviewer feedback, this probe investigates *why* my KronoNetV4 architecture is effective. It quantitatively tests the hypothesis that the recurrent backbone produces temporally structured ('stateful') features, unlike a simple CNN. The probe measures the temporal similarity of feature maps from both backbones. This will provide deeper insight for a future publication.
